name: 漫画节奏卡
purpose: Design preview only; no application source changes
prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished visual DESIGN PROPOSAL board for a Chinese mobile app called oneBeat. This is OPTION A: a cream paper comic rhythm-editing dialog. This is a brand-new design mockup, not implementation.
Output: landscape presentation board approximately 1536 x 1024, warm pale gray background, TWO large portrait mobile screen captures side by side, each with the realistic aspect ratio of a 390 x 844 phone. No physical device bezels, hands, 3D mockup or perspectives. A small elegant title outside screens at top: "A · 漫画节奏卡". Under the title, small concise outside-app annotations above the two screens: "待试听" and "播放中 · 自动跟随". Main visual focus is UI, tiny tasteful board typography. High fidelity, genuinely usable native mobile interface, very crisp and carefully aligned.

APP VISUAL LANGUAGE: warm off-white paper #FFF9EE with extremely subtle paper fiber, dark charcoal ink #171B1F, coral #FF7056 primary action, muted lilac #C5B7EB secondary action, white #FFFDF8. Bold confident Chinese title, slightly italic headline, handmade black contours with tiny irregularity. Compact near-hard black offset shadows 3px right /4px down. Modest 6-8px corners. Friendly comic editorial style, refined and spare, not crude sketching. No scenic illustration, characters, mascots, excessive stickers, gradients, neon, glassmorphism, glowing pads, knobs or chrome.

OPTION A LAYOUT:
Each phone screen has a centered large paper dialog, approximately 362px wide and 600px high in the phone's logical390x844 canvas. Outside dialog a softly dimmed simple cream app background with indistinct gray silhouettes of cards, no readable extra controls. The dialog has warm white surface, ink 2px outline, offset ink shadow. Inside16px padding, comfortable spacing and typographic hierarchy, no wasted blank vertical areas.
Header: small outlined paper tag "段落 A", a prominent bold title "编辑加花", a small dark outlined circular close "×" on far right. A SHORT coral ink underline underneath the title, not covering text. In a concise metadata row below: clear badge "4/4" and label "第 1 小节". Then the single instruction "点击格子开关鼓点" in small dark-gray text.
Main editor is a highly legible paper music worksheet. A FIXED LEFT LABEL RAIL with EXACTLY EIGHT rows, in this exact order:
1 底鼓
2 军鼓
3 闭镲
4 开镲
5 拍手
6 低通鼓
7 高通鼓
8 打击乐
All eight labels must be clearly rendered on BOTH phone screens. Small optional ink line-art percussion doodles beside labels are purely decorative and restrained, not buttons. No mute/solo switches or volume sliders.
To right, horizontal scrollable drum-step grid, exactly8 VISIBLE step columns at a time, 32-34px logical size,8 aligned track rows, softly rounded rectangular cells. All cells have same geometry. Thin muted gray cell outlines; strong ink rules only at beat boundaries so grid is calm. Inactive cells warm pale oatmeal #E9E2D5. Active beat/downbeat cells coral; active subdivisions muted lilac. Tiny solid inset highlight or subtle offset shadow on active cells, no luminosity. Light alternating four-column beat group tint, gaps slightly larger only BETWEEN beats. A beat ruler row and continuous numbered step row precisely aligned with cells, fixed label rail not scrolling.
Left idle screen: ruler groups "第 1 拍" over columns1-4 and "第 2 拍" over5-8; numbered row exactly "1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8". A tasteful small rightward scroll hint as scrollbar/arrow below grid (presentation of existing horizontal scrolling, not a new control), indicates more beats offscreen.
Right playing screen: same UI now automatically scrolled to SECOND half of same4/4 measure; ruler groups "第 3 拍" and "第 4 拍"; numbered row exactly "9 10 11 12 13 14 15 16". Fixed track labels remain unchanged. A single thin dark continuous vertical playhead line at step11 stretches from ruler top through ALL EIGHT drum rows, with a tiny coral triangle cap in ruler to clearly locate current playback. It must NOT stop halfway through tracks. A very faint warm coral column tint around playhead is allowed to improve scanability.
Use a plausible sparse fill pattern across all8 tracks: several kick/snare hits, regular closed hats, few openhat/clap, tom roll denser in later beat. Do not fill every cell. Do not use extra grid rows.
Footer inside dialog: three aligned buttons at same height48px. Left secondary white "取消", middle lilac with triangle icon "试听", right wider coral "应用到加花". Black outlined near-hard shadows. On right playing screen middle label is square stop icon plus "停止" instead. Existing "取消" and "应用到加花" stay the same. Primary action width about1.8x other buttons, text readable and no wrapping.

FEATURE SCOPE STRICT: only close, meter4/4, sectionA, measure1, tap-to-toggle8-track step grid, beat/step numbers, horizontal scrolling, audition/stop, full-height playhead auto-follow, cancel and apply-to-fill. NO BPM info, transport time, start/rewind buttons, save button, edit tabs, new modes, undo/redo, mute/solo, velocity, track addition, pattern selector or unrelated information. No new features. All labels in Chinese as supplied. Use correct Chinese typography with no gibberish. Ensure readable full8track grid in both screens.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached A · 漫画节奏卡 two-state design board. Keep its entire composition, dialog layout, sizes, all eight drum row labels in both screens, all text, typography, paper texture, black contour/shadow, palette, footer actions, fixed labels and horizontal scrolling presentation.
Make only these precise UI polish corrections:
1. The existing app has consistent drum-cell COLOR SEMANTICS. Coral #FF7056 may appear ONLY in active cells of the FIRST subdivision of each beat. Left screen (columns1..8): coral is allowed ONLY in columns1 and5. Right screen (columns9..16): coral is allowed ONLY in columns9 and13. EVERY active cell in any other column must be muted lilac #C5B7EB. Keep inactive oatmeal cells unchanged and preserve which cells are on/off. For example the left closed-hat hits at3,7 and tom hits at7,8 must become lilac; right hits at11,14,15,16 must become lilac. Other coral header accents and coral Apply buttons stay unchanged.
2. Right screen playback marker cap currently obscures the numeral11. Move the tiny coral triangle cap UP into beat header above the numbered step row. Numbered row must clearly and completely read "9 10 11 12 13 14 15 16". Preserve the thin dark vertical playhead at column11 and extend it continuously through every one of the8rows; thin line must not obscure numeral11 (can run just to left edge of its cell). Keep very subtle playing-column tint.
Do not change other text or add controls/features. Preserve left button labels 取消 / 试听 / 应用到加花 and right labels 取消 / 停止 / 应用到加花. Exactly8tracks 底鼓 军鼓 闭镲 开镲 拍手 低通鼓 高通鼓 打击乐. No app code or hardware mocks.
